headline: Callahan's Passage Leads Active Fronts as Palantine Berm Cools
war_summary: The picture has shifted again: Callahan's Passage now carries the liveliest dispatch, twenty-two base actions in the day's ledger and three inside the final two hours, the latest filed as this edition goes to press. Crumbling Post and The Crumbling Passage bore the brunt, with Colonial losses accelerating even as Warden figures hold level. Palantine Berm still leads the day's count at thirty-two actions, yet its tempo has cooled sharply, scarcely a dozen losses an hour where a hundred figured earlier. The Nevish Line keeps seething, twenty-one actions behind it, its eight posts now standing four Warden, three Colonial, one in no-man's-land. The Weathered Expanse, busiest ground of the day at thirty-two actions, has seen no base movement in nine hours, though its casualty rolls stay heavy, three hundred seventy-five Warden and two hundred nineteen Colonial in two hours. The Stlican Shelf has been still since half past midnight, five Colonial to three Warden with one post demolished, and Kuura Strand sleeps on. Mooring County is sparing with flags but not with blood, four hundred Colonial and three hundred twelve Warden losses in two hours near The Wind Hills. It is day 470; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize, and no victor is named.
